svg.title: meeg-utils architecture
svg.desc: Recordings are read with their BIDS sidecars, checked by the acquisition QC, preprocessed run by run (an EEG and an MEG lane), epoched and combined per session. Every box names the class behind it; every step can be changed.
svg.text: flat · clipped · bridged · impedance · outlying channels
line & narrowband noise · muscle · blinks · heartbeat
head movement · cHPI · SQUID jumps · empty room
Presets eeg-erp · eeg-rest · meg-erp · meg-rest · had-meeg are ordinary pipelines: set_params, replace, insert or remove any step
